name: Mendocino Animal Hospital
description: Mendocino Animal Hospital provides veterinary care for dogs in Ukiah, CA. Confirm hours and services directly with the clinic.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: The Mendocino Animal Hospital staff are the most amazing group of people. The receptionists, doctors, nurses, and vet techs have the biggest hearts. They truly care about what is best for pets and their owners.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Mendocino Animal Hospital has always been there for me and my guys. They truly are caring. They recently went above and beyond for me and my little guy. They were there to help inform me while making a very difficult decision."

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Incredibly supportive and loving doctors, nurses and staff! The family at Mendocino Animal Hospital truly love their fur-patients. They go out of their way to make sure your pets are well taken care of. I highly recommend this vet if you want quality support and care for your pet!
